r: Hmpf, I will kill you ten more times if needed.

ortholion_1.m: Look, I don't have time for you, but I don't kill kids, not yet. So step aside.
r: I'm here to inform you about Ehrenfest. He's probably behind some disappearances in Prim.

ortholion_10a.m: Did he tell you... *looks around* Better not here.

ortholion_10b.m: I would duel you here and prove you wrong, but this is really no place to talk. These strange creatures don't cease to appear.

ortholion_11.m: Yes, yes... I'll get out of this cave. Meet me at the entrance of the mine. There is a large dining room. That will suffice.
r: You are of no interest to me. Bye.
Are you sure you don't need an escort?

ortholion_12.m:
A knight's only trustworthy escorts are his sword and his horse. 

*gets up* I'm pretty sure you'll find the way out.

ortholion_13.m: This isn't really the way I planned this.

ortholion_14.m: *looking at you* But thanks to your act of bravery, I'm alive and not injured... Not severely.

ortholion_15a.m: I am sorry, but that is none of your concern. As I said you've lent me a hand when I was vulnerable. That won't be forgotten.
r: You owe me a favor then.

ortholion_15b.m: And you do good. Trust should be neither easy to gain nor easy to lose.
r: Yeah, yeah. Where's my reward for saving your life?

ortholion_16a.m:
A reward? This does not work that way...What would Feygard think of my assassination? Who would be blamed for that?

The reward is I'm alive and no army will chase you.
r: *laughing* Do you think a few drunkards could beat me?
But at least, you owe me a favor. Where's your honor?

ortholion_16b.m: Let me settle that debt then.

ortholion_16d.m: I will ask you again. What in this world is most important to you?
r: The Shadow's teachings are the only thing that matters.
My family is the most important thing to me.

ortholion_17.m: Let me ask you a question. What in the world is most important to you? Pride and honor? Maybe power and riches?
r: I need some time to think about it.
I can't conceive a life without honor.
My father, Mikhail, and my brother Andor.

ortholion_17a.m: Doesn't matter whether they could or not. They won't come after you, and that's what my reward is.

ortholion_18a.m: I'm patient, but I won't be here forever. Other issues demand my presence.
r: Cut it out and give me my reward!

ortholion_18b.m: Well, yes. Every old and tired adventurer's dream I guess, but I somewhat expected more of you. Take this and don't bother me anymore. *shows you a medium-sized bag of gold and jewels*
r: Don't be so greedy. Give me more!

ortholion_18c.m: Good answer! That is very inline with any good Feygard soldier thoughts. Since I owe you a favor, let me repay you with this bag of gold.
r: I can't accept gold for saving someone's life...

ortholion_18d.m: I would say that is a ... very ignorant reply, but I will not judge you today. Go back home and spend some time with your people and your family; then come back. I will need people like you in a few days.
r: I'll remember to come back, farewell.

ortholion_18e.m: Hah! You really are either so brave or so dumb confessing that in a place full of Feygard soldiers.
r: Those who don't believe will eventually be punished!
You couldn't land a single hit on me!

ortholion_19a.m: Fine. Now let some days pass and meet me again here. I may need your help and you may want more gold.

ortholion_19b.m: I see, I see. You're a clever guy *makes signs to two soldiers*. Take this much larger bag full of jewels my men have been gathering... from the mines.
r: Ehm... I'd rather take the small bag, thanks. [Take the gold]

ortholion_19c.m: Should I be surprised? That shows how valuable your word currently is. Come back in a few days and I may change my opinion if you're willing to help me.
r: I'll think about it, but you'd better pay me next time!

ortholion_19d.m:
*Withdraws his hand with the gold bag and makes a nod of approval* Good, good. I accept your choice. Since you said you are not going to accept gold, take this as a sign of my gratitude.

We'll talk later. Now we all need some rest.
r: Thank you, I will keep it as the most valuable treasure.
I will keep it as my most precious treasure. [Lie]

ortholion_19e.m: Look, this is simple. The Shadow is the past. We, Feygard, are the future. Fanaticism is never a good companion, but you are still young, you will need time to fully understand my words.
r: You forbid the use of Bonemeal!
You put unfair taxes and censor people's beliefs!

ortholion_20a.m: Fine, it's all for you. Maybe this way you'll learn a lesson. Come see me in some days, you might be of use.
r: A bag full of junk necklaces and rings?! No way, trickster!

ortholion_20b.m: Not everything is black or white. Taxes are needed in this great kingdom in order to keep the peace and the roads safe.

ortholion_20c.m: Would you like your bones be used in some sort of ritual to make those potions? Because in winter, when big mammals, erumen lizards, and other beasts hibernate, there's only one kind of bones useful for that: ours.
r: That sounds kind of true. You are a very persuasive speaker.

ortholion_2b.m: You mean that weakling is responsible of those missing people from Prim of whom I've been recently informed?
r: Weakling? Haven't you seen how he escaped?

ortholion_3b.m: Nothing impressive. Loyal followers of the Shadow have their tricks, just as I have my own.
r: The Shadow? Do you believe in that?
Hope those tricks are better than your chasing abilities.

ortholion_3b2.m: There's definitely something off with him. Another Shadow fanatic to get rid of, tsch.
r: Shadow fanatic? Do you know him?

ortholion_4a.m: Hmm...Maybe. You came up this far after all. Go warn my soldiers. They are settled in the tunnel entrance, south of Prim.
r: This is getting too complicated. I'd better leave.
I bet they'll pay attention to a kid like me, right?

ortholion_4b.m: [Laughs quietly] Only simple minds would see things as black or white. Whether I believe or not, people do, and we in Feygard keep that in mind.
r: OK. Now that you're aware of the situation, I'd better leave.
What about "I don't have time to..."?

ortholion_4c.m: I have no time for this absurd talk. I must be sure this guy's road ends in the Elm mine.

ortholion_4d.m: No. But it's quite obvious by the way he accused me.
r: And what will you do, General Slowness?
Well, this is not really my problem. Bye.

ortholion_5a.m: Not so fast. Seeing that you reached this place but my scouts couldn't, I think you will be of use.
r: What if I don't want to help you?

ortholion_6a.m: Then I'll officially accuse you of betrayal and attempted murder against a Feygard general. I'll bring you to Feygard and you will never see your family again.
r: How dare you?! Prepare to die!

ortholion_6b.m: Take this, and show it to the soldiers stationed near the mining tunnel entrance. Tell them I went to the Elm mine.

ortholion_7a.m:
[The general effortlessly subdues you, and begins to laugh] 

Look, take this signet. With this, my soldiers stationed outside the mining tunnel entrance will believe your words. Tell them I went to the Elm mine.
r: OK, OK. I will but please don't hurt me anymore.

ortholion_8a.m: Are you still here?! Go, go now!
r: Someday you will regret your manners...

ortholion_9.m: *looks at you* Humilliating. How did I...? How did that guy...?

ortholion_busy2.m: Oh, $playername...I'm sorry but I have many things to discuss and attend to here, come back later.

ortholion_c2.m:
Oh. Alright, we will chat later. Now we're going out of the...

WATCH OUT!

ortholion_c3.m: Tsch, you cannot lose! I'm still recovering.

ortholion_conscious.m: Uhm... What a thwack. $playername, where's the...

ortholion_conversation2_1.m: Ehrenfest, you have come this far just to get rid of me...
r: Ehrenfest, here I am to help you.
Ortholion, beware! He is a dangerous liar!

ortholion_conversation2_2a.m: The crimes you have commited must be punished!

ortholion_conversation2_2b.m: I hoped someone else would take the blame for this. But don't worry, soon we shall be unstoppable.
r: Do you always talk this much, liar?

ortholion_conversation2_3a.m:
Hmmm... What crimes, evil creature?

You even dared to think you had a chance to trick a general of glorious Feygard?!

ortholion_conversation2_3b.m: [unsheathes his sword] Well, enough talk. I won't ignore your threats, evil creature.
r: Ehrenfest, you have many things to explain!

ortholion_conversation2_4a.m:
I'm... [stares at you] 

$playername! It's time to end with all of this!
r: Right! Ortholion must pay for killing innocent people from Prim!

ortholion_conversation2_4b.m:
[People from the tavern start looking at the place where Ortholion and Ehrenfest are about to have a fight]

[looks around] No...Not yet. Argh! You kid, betrayer! You are about to discover how wrongly you have chosen!

ortholion_conversation2_5a.m: A kid? You come with a kid accusing me of something I never heard about?

ortholion_conversation2_5a2.m: General Ortholion ignores you and continues to speak to Ehrenfest.

ortholion_conversation2_5b.m:
[The general tries to land a strike on Ehrenfest, but he just cuts a piece of his cloak. Ehrenfest is gone]

Hmpf...
r: I thought Feygard generals were faster swinging their blades.

ortholion_conversation2_6a.m: Ehrenfest, you have bothered me more than I am willing to abide. Blackwater Settlement guards will take care of you.
r: Those guards are no match for...

ortholion_conversation2_6a2.m: Just before starting to launch an attack, General Ortholion moves and disarms you with a single blow.

ortholion_conversation2_7a.m:
Bah! This is enough. $playername. Weren't you so strong? Pathetic.

You only had to distract him and take the blame!
r: Hah. I always knew you were far too shady to be an honest man.

ortholion_conversation2_8a.m:
Ortholion! How much is your life worth? How many people?

Prove the honor of your glorious land. Come face me alone! No guards, no witnesses.

[Ehrenfest leaps unnaturally high, passing above you, and disappears in the blink of an eye]

ortholion_unconscious.m: The kick was so brutal that Ortholion fell unconscious.

Omi2_bwm1.5: Down in a hole, in the mountain side near Prim, I found signs of a heinous torture. At least three corpses were there. I felt the urge to get out of there as fast as I could and immediately report what I found to someone in the village.
Omi2_bwm1.6: A mysterious looking guy suddenly appeared in my way when I was headed to report to the guards. He has recommended that I should not tell them anything.
Omi2_bwm1.7: I ignored the advice of the strange guy that I almost stumbled over. I must see some guards.
Omi2_bwm1.8: Somehow, a Feygard general and his men reached Prim. They are kind of extorting the people in charge to get full control of Elm mine.
Omi2_bwm1.9: The man in charge is not willing to listen to me. He says he has more important things to deal with. Maybe the guy I met earlier was right.
Omi2_bwm1.10: A Feygard general and two of his henchmen appeared. What are they up to?
Omi2_bwm1.11: Ehrenfest is uneasy. He said we must meet in Elm mine, west of prim. We should talk no more about this inside the village.
Omi2_bwm1.15: Ehrenfest told me his story, and why he knew about what I saw on the mountain side, but he didn't dare to go down the hole.
Omi2_bwm1.16: I explained to Ehrenfest the horrible scene, and showed him proof of the torture. Poor guys...
Omi2_bwm1.20: I must ask the villagers about Lorn and his partners, maybe I can gather some useful information from the common gossip.
Omi2_bwm1.21: It seems Lorn was a regular client of the tavern. I should ask there.
Omi2_bwm1.22: One of the tavern regulars, possibly Lorn's old partner Jern, does not believe that Lorn's death was an accident, maintaining Lorn had been climbing the mountains for longer than he could remember. However, he does not feel comfortable to continue the conversation.
Omi2_bwm1.23: Lorn's old partner asked me to bring a large bottle of cool water from the streams that are down the hole east of Prim. I bet it is the same hole I've been down earlier.
Omi2_bwm1.24: I've collected enough water. Time to leave this dark place.
Omi2_bwm1.25: I brought the cold water to Lorn's old partner. He seems to be better, and is less intoxicated.
Omi2_bwm1.30: Jern doesn't know anything about a missing couple. How can a member of Lorn's crew ignore the mission of his group? Again, something does not fit. I should visit Ehrenfest again.
Omi2_bwm1.31: I decided to solve this situation myself, as Ehrenfest proved not to be trustworthy enough.
Omi2_bwm1.32: Despite Ehrenfest's ostensible lies, I decided to give him a second chance.
Omi2_bwm1.33: It's settled. Ehrenfest and I will reach Blackwater Settlement and stop General Ortholion's evil plan.
Omi2_bwm1.34: I've found a severely wounded woman inside a mountain cabin. She claims to have been suddenly attacked by a group of wyrms. Ortholion and the other scout left her resting and departed to Blackwater Settlement.
Omi2_bwm1.35: I killed the mountain scout that was taking refuge in the old cabin up in the mountain.
Omi2_bwm1.36: I talked again with Jern. Maybe the guards will be more reasonable if he leads the conversation instead of me.
Omi2_bwm1.40: It seems Ehrenfest lied to me more than once. He's probably connected with the missing people and Lorn's death. I must find General Ortholion and warn him about Ehrenfest.
Omi2_bwm1.41: One of the general's henchmen attacked me without provocation. There was something wrong with her. Better hurry up and meet with the Feygard general.
Omi2_bwm1.45: Ehrenfest revealed his true intentions, but fled before getting surrounded. He told me he will be waiting for General Ortholion in the Elm mine.
Omi2_bwm1.46: After a brief conversation with the general, he left Blackwater settlement in a rush to reach Elm mine. He seemed really worried about the mine, so he asked me to warn his soldiers, settled south of Prim.
Omi2_bwm1.47: I reported to the general's henchmen about his plans. Now, I should hurry to the Elm mine.
Omi2_bwm1.48: Once in the mine I saw corpses and collapsed tunnels. I tried to go another way and reached some more tunnels. Fortunately, they were not collapsed, but there was something strange there that scared even the venomfangs. Something evil.
Omi2_bwm1.49: One of the unexploited areas of the mine had a walled up passage and lots of those strange glowing gems. They seem to consume living beings to grow and bring life to inanimated things or corpses. I must be very careful.
Omi2_bwm1.50: It was true! That strange glowing material is alive. I should be extremely cautious; it seems to be able to engulf living beings. I found the last of Ortholion's henchman alive. He has gone back to search for reinforcements. I hope they are better than those who dared to enter here.
Omi2_bwm1.51: I ended up trapped on a one-way path deep in a cavern below the Elm mine. General Ortholion is blocking the only way to escape for Ehrenfest. This is his end.
Omi2_bwm1.52: Ehrenfest reversed the situation using some kind of magic, seemingly unknown even to himself.
Omi2_bwm1.53: Ehrenfest escaped again! General Ortholion is unconscious and the reinforcements haven't shown up yet...
Omi2_bwm1.54: Kamelio, who was no longer a human being, tried to kill both the general and me, but we survived. Better get out of this cavern as soon as possible.
Omi2_bwm1.55: I got back to the Elm mine dining room. Despite saving the general's life he's not eager to reward me. Maybe I should try again later when we are both more settled.
Omi2_bwm1.56: After arriving back at a safer place, General Ortholion asked me a question. "What is most important to you?" I need to think about it before giving him my reply.
Omi2_bwm1.59: For my bravery, General Ortholion rewarded me with a lot of gold and told me to meet him in a couple of days.
Omi2_bwm1.60: For my bravery (and my greediness), General Ortholion rewarded me with a lot of...junk. He might pay me better next time if I meet him in some days.
Omi2_bwm1.61: For my bravery (and my lack of honor), General Ortholion rewarded me with a small bag of gold. He may have some news for me in a couple of days.
Omi2_bwm1.62: For my bravery and sense of honor, General Ortholion gave me a beautiful necklace, a symbol of his gratitude towards me. He also told me to come back in a few days, when I should ask him about all the events that have happened.
Omi2_bwm1.63: For my bravery and... ignorance?, General Ortholion gave me a few days to rest and urged me to come back soon after that.

bwm72_beginning.6: Conversation with Ehrenfest starts before Ortholion appears.
bwm72_beginning.7: Conversation with Ehrenfest starts after Ortholion leaves.
bwm72_beginning.8: Ehrenfest notices your presence in the mine and calls you.
bwm72_beginning.35: Bad opinion from Ortholion's remaining henchman
